name: Solstice USX
oneLiner: USX is Solstice's Solana dollar with Chainlink PoR and institutional redemption; retail holders rely on DEX liquidity during stress.
collateral: USDC and USDT deposited 1:1; plans to expand to SOL, ETH, and BTC collateral
pegMechanism: 1:1 collateralization with multi-oracle pricing via Chainlink and Pyth; Chainlink Proof of Reserve provides real-time on-chain verification of reserves; institutional minting ($500K minimum, KYC-gated); permissionless access via Solana DEXs

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 421873034, the USX mint listed Ze3CQhTMi6KMU3nWZQUegA2JpeFd2eMx1Y2Gswqnto4 as its live freezeAuthority as well as mintAuthority. The authority account is owned by the Solstice USX program, so the program can directly freeze individual USX token accounts and thereby restrict their transfers.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: USX is an institutional/KYC Solana token with live SPL mint and freeze authority held by a Solstice program-owned account (Ze3CQhTMi6...), and the program upgrade authority is a Solstice-operated EOA (BzMuMbtah9...). All mint-capable controls confirmed on-chain.

controls.label: USX SPL mint and freeze authority
controls.evidence: The USX Solana mint had this address as both mintAuthority and freezeAuthority at finalized slot 421873034; the account is owned by the Solstice USX program and is not executable.

controls.label: Solstice USX program upgrade authority (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Solana slot 425778559, getAccountInfo for BzMuMbtah9bqN4HERkPo2PsVoaQKD2xfvYq1xfDCFwEb returned owner: 11111111111111111111111111111111 (System Program), executable: false, lamports: 8097020. This is a funded EOA (Solstice backend/dev wallet, not a multisig or program). It holds the BPF upgrade authority for program USXyiSTsPEWz55pSK7sZoUL79ntoVGQbaTDT57tH6bx.

review.evidence: At Solana slot 425778559: mint authority Ze3CQhTMi6KMU3nWZQUegA2JpeFd2eMx1Y2Gswqnto4 (program-owned account) confirmed as direct-minter; program upgrade authority BzMuMbtah9bqN4HERkPo2PsVoaQKD2xfvYq1xfDCFwEb confirmed as funded EOA (owner: System Program, not executable, 8M lamports). All mint-capable controls are issuer-operated EOA/program-owned — consistent with centralized-dependent permissioned-minter model.

notices.title: Retail redemption gap and thin-liquidity depeg
notices.message: USX traded as low as roughly $0.10 on Orca during a December 2025 thin-liquidity event. Solstice documents institutional/KYC redemption, so retail holders without direct redemption access depend on secondary-market liquidity during stress.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: USX is issued against deposited USDC and USDT reserves; oracle monitoring does not turn the reserve receipt into a CDP.
